PLAN "Deload Week 5 — Post-Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "reduce fatigue and maintain movement quality"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload Week" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper A Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 2x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper B Deload":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x3..5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 2x4..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
